rationale: I read the complete held EO 12785 (56 FR 67451, Dec. 30, 1991): one sentence amending sec. 4(b) of EO 12687 (President's Education Policy Advisory Committee) by replacing the date December 31, 1991 with December 31, 1992; no own term, no savings clause, and its effect exists only as text of EO 12687. I read the held full text of EO 12869 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, 58 FR 51751, Oct. 4, 1993, signed Sept. 30, 1993): sec. 4 reads 'The following Executive orders or sections thereof, which established committees that have terminated or whose work is completed, are revoked' and sec. 4(e) lists 'Executive Order No. 12687, as amended by Executive Orders Nos. 12741 and 12785, establishing the President's Education Policy Advisory Committee'; sec. 6 makes the order effective September 30, 1993; there is no savings clause. That names EO 12785 itself and removes the whole base order it amended. D6 self-check (later events and acting instruments after the cited basis): the history has one observation, an empty catalog note, and no events. A search of all held texts for 12687 and 12785 finds only EO 12687, EO 12741 (earlier extension, Dec. 31, 1990 to Dec. 31, 1991, before EO 12785), EO 12869 and the page-overlap copy in the EO 12868 file; nothing after Sept. 30, 1993 re-establishes, re-extends or revives the Committee, and EO 12869 sec. 5 supersedes only EO 12774. The extended term in EO 12785 (to Dec. 31, 1992) would also have run out before the revocation, so no earlier ending changes the result. The report-deadline and cross-reference machinery plays no role. Provisional NO hypothesis only; the exact end date (Dec. 31, 1992 by own term, or Sept. 30, 1993 by revocation) is not adjudicated.
